svg.title: FPGA supply pins bypass network and unused pads
svg.text: ENER / FPGA SUPPLY PINS BYPASS NETWORK AND UNUSED PADS
FHE + NEUROMORPHIC RELAY | REFERENCE DESIGN B | 2026-09-05
Schematic design and simulated logic; PCB and assembled hardware not validated.
C14/C15 at core pins 5/30; C16/C17/C18 at I/O pins 1/22/33; C19 at VPP pin 24.
R17 with C20/C21 filters VCCPLL; connect the rail even though the PLL is unused.
Pad 49 is the exposed ground paddle: connect to the ground plane with a thermal/via array.
Unused pads shown with an X have no copper connection. Confirm unused-I/O constraints in the final bitstream.
